kb_left_arrow.action: Move Madeline left / aim dash left

kb_right_arrow.action: Move Madeline right / aim dash right

kb_up_arrow.action: Move Madeline up / aim dash up

kb_down_arrow.action: Move Madeline down / aim dash down (also crouch/look down)

kb_x.action: Dash / Talk to NPCs (also Cancel/back in menus)

left_joy_up.action: Move up / aim dash up (analog stick)

left_joy_down.action: Move down / aim dash down (analog stick)

left_joy_left.action: Move left / aim dash left (analog stick)

left_joy_right.action: Move right / aim dash right (analog stick)

disputed.back: Some sources say the Journal (stats/collectibles screen) opens with the controller's Back/View button by default, but this could not be confirmed in the actual game settings file, which lists no default controller binding (BtnJournal) for it — it may be hardcoded or menu-only.
disputed.quick_restart_controller: Older guides say holding both shoulder buttons (LB+RB) plus Start triggers Quick Restart on controller, but patch notes indicate this hardcoded shortcut was later removed in favor of a rebindable 'Alt Quick Restart' which ships with NO default button assigned (BtnAltQuickRestart was empty in the actual settings file read). Could not confirm a current default controller quick-restart binding.
disputed.kb_escape: Not listed inside the <Pause/> tag of the actual settings.celeste config file (it was empty), suggesting Pause may be a hardcoded, non-remappable Escape key rather than a normal default binding — but every secondary source agrees Escape is used, so confidence is still fairly high.

source.note: This is a real Celeste settings.celeste save-config file (the game's actual XML config format) containing default keyboard (Grab/Jump/Dash/Talk/Confirm/Cancel/Journal/QuickRestart) and controller (BtnGrab/BtnJump/BtnDash/BtnTalk) bindings, cross-checked against magicgameworld.com's 'Celeste Controls Guide: Default Binds' and multiple Steam Community discussion threads which independently reported the same C/X/Z keyboard scheme and A-Y jump / X-B dash / LT-RT-LB-RB grab controller scheme. PCGamingWiki, Neoseeker, Celeste Fandom wiki, and celeste.ink were all blocked (403/CAPTCHA) and could not be read directly.
